# ARLA

> ARLA is a melodic techno DJ and producer from Barcelona, Spain.

- **Artist name:** ARLA
- **Role:** DJ and music producer
- **Based in:** Barcelona, Spain
- **Genre:** Melodic techno
- **Total streams:** 1M+
- **Supported by:** Gordo, SCRIPT, braev
- **Supported at:** Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Afterlife Festival, UNVRS
- **Bookings, remixes and demos:** contact@arlamusic.com
- **Website:** https://arlamusic.com/

## Official remixes

- **When I Close My Eyes (ARLA & BAAT Remix)** — original by DALEXO, Adrian Fyrla, Boix & Breakloop, GiPX. https://fanlink.tv/when-i-close-my-eyes-arla-baat-remix
- **K.O. (ARLA Remix)** — original by LAVINIA & Ely Oaks. https://fanlink.tv/ko-arla-remix
- **Call Me (ARLA Remix)** — original by Brian Cross, DALEXO & Kelly Matejcic. https://streamlink.to/call-me-roger-arola-remix
- **Arriba! (BAAT & ARLA Remix)** — original by Marsal Ventura, DJ Pelos & Jbill. https://streamlink.to/arriba-baat-arla-remix

ARLA is a music artist. Not to be confused with Arla Foods, the Danish–Swedish dairy cooperative, or with any similarly named clothing brand.
